API_contract.finding: POST HTTPS api.typesafe.ai:443/v1/systemone; model/state/questions; Bearer authentication; answers/model/usage. No provider-domain access during this readiness task.

API_entitlement.finding: Historical calls do not establish current account entitlement.
API_entitlement.operator_confirmation_required: Confirm the named intended account currently has direct SystemOne API entitlement, with a dated non-secret attestation.

requested_fixed_model.finding: Preserved documentation says versioned IDs can be requested; the sealed request chooses jev-1.13.0. No account model-list endpoint was invoked.

current_jev_1_13_0_availability.finding: No current account-specific access or retention guarantee is available.
current_jev_1_13_0_availability.operator_confirmation_required: Confirm jev-1.13.0 is available to that account for the intended execution window, without substituting an alias or a newer revision.

account_permission_for_probe.finding: No account owner/tenant permission for this proposed probe was established.
account_permission_for_probe.operator_confirmation_required: Confirm account owner permission, permissible purpose and permitted charges for this exact synthetic one-request probe.

account_price_and_spend_restrictions.finding: No authoritative SystemOne account tariff or enforceable spend/usage limit is evidenced. Frozen reference rates concern other routes; no estimate is promoted to a cap.
account_price_and_spend_restrictions.operator_confirmation_required: Confirm tariff, units, rounding/minimum charges, error/timeout/replay charges, account balance and enforceable cap semantics. Supply an evidenced maximum exposure for the proposed request.

provider_request_correlation.finding: The broker captures generic request-ID headers if supplied; no documented guaranteed identifier/request-digest/account-ledger association was established.
provider_request_correlation.operator_confirmation_required: Confirm the exact durable provider identifier and how it binds the one local request to serving and billing records.

serving_model_self_report.finding: Response model is a service self-report. Local TLS schema/model matching is not an independent serving-weight/revision attestation.

independent_serving_identity.finding: Immutable weights/configuration and independently verifiable revision evidence remain unestablished.
independent_serving_identity.operator_confirmation_required: Confirm version-ID immutability and available serving evidence, or explicitly identify the assurance limit for PI consideration.

local_dispatch_and_no_retransmission.finding: Saved accepted histories reconstruct with one reservation per position; one client POST is permitted. This is local evidence, not remote execution count.

remote_retry_replay.finding: No provider-internal attempt guarantee or provider idempotency mechanism is established. SDK client retries are documented, but this transport uses no provider SDK.
remote_retry_replay.operator_confirmation_required: Confirm internal retry/replay, idempotency and billing semantics for one accepted POST. Do not equate local idempotency tokens with provider guarantees.

timeout_and_ambiguous_execution.finding: Local deadline/no-reissue and uncertain-completion custody are qualified. Remote cancellation or continued execution after disconnect is not established.
timeout_and_ambiguous_execution.operator_confirmation_required: Confirm continued execution/cancellation, completion evidence and timeout charges; provide a no-resubmission reconciliation procedure.

usage_counter_schema.finding: The API documents usage counters and the parser preserves them; a local fixture receipt is not an account consumption record.

usage_billing_reconciliation.finding: No account-specific request-to-usage/billing reconciliation evidence is available.
usage_billing_reconciliation.operator_confirmation_required: Confirm ledger/export fields, units, posting delay and how a timed-out or missing-response attempt is reconciled without another inference call.

production_egress_deployment.finding: Host operator has CapEff=0 and cannot inspect host nftables rules. The code checks loopback-only interfaces and an exact local IP/port policy; production route admission is intentionally absent.
production_egress_deployment.operator_confirmation_required: Approve a least-privilege production broker deployment and supply reviewed numeric destination(s), namespace/routing/firewall configuration and deployment authority. No provider DNS/connectivity tests are authorised here.

production_TLS_trust.finding: Explicit local public-CA loading with certificate/hostname verification works; no production trust configuration or provider chain has been approved or inspected.
production_TLS_trust.operator_confirmation_required: Review and approve explicit trust anchors/configuration for the exact hostname. Review locally supplied public material without contacting the provider.

credential_provisioning.finding: Only BrokerSecret protocol plus hardwired FixtureSecret exists. No approved source, broker-specific service or principal/access policy was identified; generic systemd availability is not approval.
credential_provisioning.operator_confirmation_required: Identify an already approved available mechanism and its non-secret binding metadata: broker principal, scope, expiry/account attribution, access policy, dump/ptrace protections and delivery interface. Do not supply or inspect a key during readiness review.

credential_non_disclosure.finding: Inherited environment stripping and closed descriptors are reusable; fixture canary-specific header scrubbing does not establish arbitrary real-secret handling. No unrelated-process access protection is qualified for a live broker.
credential_non_disclosure.operator_confirmation_required: Before a real hookup, verify arbitrary dummy-secret non-disclosure and access denial under the chosen deployment. Include failure paths/reflected headers without altering historical evidence.

PI_live_authority.finding: No live permission exists; DISABLED is enforced and the default production route refuses before dispatch.
